metaDescription: Eco-friendly custom wheat straw journals & notebooks for bulk orders. Perfect for sustainable branding. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Wheat straw journals and notebooks offer a sustainable alternative to traditional paper products, made from agricultural waste that would otherwise be burned. The natural flecked texture gives each cover a unique, earthy look that aligns with green initiatives. Ideal for trade shows, corporate gifts, or employee onboarding kits, these notebooks can be debossed or screen-printed with your logo. Choose wheat straw to reduce plastic use while providing a practical, everyday writing tool your recipients will actually use.
